title: Greece Has Its Own Pompeii, and the Ruins Tell a Captivating Story of a Sophisticated, Seafaring Bronze Age Society
caption:
Unlike Pompeii, the ancient Greek city of Akrotiri contains no human remains. Archaeologists found that these Bronze Age people were sophisticated enough to recognize the volcanic warning signs and evacuate their entire civilization before the disaster.

Source: Smithsonianmag - Greece Has Its Own Pompeii, and the Ruins Tell a Captivating Story of a Sophisticated, Seafaring Bronze Age Society
